name: Custom Elasticsearch MCP Server
description: A high-performance MCP server that connects tools like Cursor to Elasticsearch clusters using public-key authorization instead of API keys. It provides optimized tools for searching data, listing indices, and inspecting cluster mappings or shards with support for concurrent requests.
